paths.description: Public root disclaimer: the site’s only discovered first-party page/template; tested default, dark, contrast, reduced-motion, mobile, crawler/no-JS, network, performance, accessibility, security, and memory conditions.
Representative HTTP failure state for recovery/resilience. External surveza.ai legal pages were not covered because they are a separate host and template.

findings.summary: The page ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical in presentation to the default screenshot, and the DOM reports color-scheme: normal with a white main surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and provide preference-driven surface, text, link, and decorative colours using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is deliberately removed from links.
findings.evidence: The computed-style focus probe focused all nine links and reported outline-style none; normalize.css includes :focus { outline: 0 } and a:active,a:hover { outline:none } without a replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the blanket outline reset and add a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator with sufficient offset.

findings.summary: The not-found state is an unbranded dead end with no recovery action.
findings.evidence: A request to /does-not-exist-audit returns the bare nginx 404 document with only “404 Not Found” and no home, support, or retry link.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 page that explains the state and links to the domain information page and support contact.

findings.summary: Cold-load paint is slower than expected for a small static disclaimer page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP and LCP at 2.7 s; the trace measured LCP at 1.31 s in a separate run, so lab variance exists but the slower run misses the 2.5 s good LCP threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-essential load-time third parties, self-host/subset the font, and keep the main content’s critical path first-party and short.

findings.summary: The mobile load shifts after initial rendering.
findings.evidence: The 360×800 layout observer measured CLS 0.0407 at about 1.46 s; both rendered images lack explicit dimensions and a remote font participates in the critical path.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the logo explicit width and height/aspect-ratio and use a metric-compatible fallback or font metric overrides for the web font.

findings.summary: Most transferred bytes are third-party and the font stylesheet blocks rendering.
findings.evidence: HAR: 21 requests/155,855 B, with 125,313 B third-party; Google Fonts CSS is parser-inserted VeryHigh priority and rtmark p.js took 891 ms despite being deferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate rtmark/Yandex unless essential, load analytics only after consent, and self-host/preload a subset font or use the system stack.

findings.summary: Analytics ships substantial unused JavaScript on a static page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 48 KiB (54%) of the 89 KiB Yandex Metrika script is unused; HAR shows scripts dominate transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove session analytics from this infrastructure notice or replace it with minimal, consented, privacy-preserving measurement.

findings.summary: Small grey body copy does not meet WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports #7d7d7d on white at 12 px has 4.11:1 contrast, below the required 4.5:1, affecting disclaimer, reporting, support, and copyright text.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken secondary text to achieve at least 4.5:1, and verify all link states at the rendered font size.

findings.summary: A dynamically inserted tracking pixel has no text alternative or presentational role.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse image-alt identifies body > img from my.rtmark.net without alt; the images primitive independently reports it missing alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer removing the tracking pixel; otherwise create it with alt="" and role="presentation" so it is ignored by assistive technology.

findings.summary: The document has no heading structure and interactive focus is invisible.
findings.evidence: DOM/probe found zero h1-h6 elements and only a main landmark; every tested link has outline none when focused.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a descriptive h1 and semantic h2 sections, then restore a visible :focus-visible treatment for links.

findings.summary: Rendered images do not reserve intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports both rendered img elements missing width and height attributes; the logo is content-visible and the other image is a tracker.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic width/height to the logo and remove the tracking pixel, or explicitly size and mark it decorative.

findings.summary: Third-party cookie operations produce browser inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices scored 0.77 and reports Cookie inspector issues across rtmark and Yandex requests, including cross-domain sync chains.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove cookie-sync integrations and only initialize essential third parties after an explicit, policy-aligned decision.

findings.summary: The page has no meta description and its title is not descriptive of the domain’s purpose.
findings.evidence: DOM and discoverability probes report title “Surveza” and no meta description; Lighthouse SEO scores meta-description 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a specific title such as “Surveza survey infrastructure notice” and add a concise description of the page and domain.

findings.summary: Public indexing signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The root returns 200 and is fully present in raw HTML, but has no canonical URL; /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both return 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical and publish robots.txt plus a minimal sitemap if this public notice should be indexed.

findings.summary: The organization/domain notice has no social preview or structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph tags despite the page identifying the responsible organization and support channel.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite JSON-LD and basic Open Graph title, description, type, and image metadata.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but CSP is absent and HSTS lasts only one second.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive: no Content-Security-Policy; Strict-Transport-Security is max-age=1. Three analytics cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and a production HSTS max-age (after rollout validation); avoid SameSite=None cookies unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: A static disclaimer starts session-wide analytics and cookie syncing without any visible choice.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 15 third-party requests and 125,313 B to five origins. DOM initializes Yandex Metrika with clickmap, trackLinks, accurateTrackBounce, and webvisor; rtmark performs pixel/cookie sync. No consent UI is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove replay/cookie-sync tracking from this page, or gate strictly necessary, minimised analytics behind valid consent and document purpose/retention.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive reports no frame protection (X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors), Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy, in addition to missing CSP.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; add X-Frame-Options for legacy defence where compatible.

findings.summary: HTTP failure handling provides no useful recovery.
findings.evidence: The representative unknown route returns a generic nginx 404 page without site identity, explanation, home link, or support route.
findings.suggestedFix: Configure the CDN/origin error document to preserve branding and give users direct recovery options.

findings.summary: The page performs disproportionate analytics and cookie-sync work for static content.
findings.evidence: 15 of 21 requests are third-party and six are redirects; Yandex/rtmark repeatedly transmit watch and sync requests even though the page has no application interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove cookie syncing/session replay and use the lightest possible aggregate measurement, deferred until needed and allowed.

findings.summary: Third parties dominate this very small page’s resource budget.
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 125,313 of 155,855 transferred bytes (80%) to third parties; the 89,997 B Yandex script is the largest resource.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a small third-party budget for the static notice and remove or delay resources that do not provide direct user value.

taskList.title: Remove or consent-gate session replay, analytics, and cookie syncing
Restore keyboard focus and semantic heading structure
Meet text contrast and image accessibility requirements
Deploy a real CSP, HSTS, and defensive browser policies
Shorten the critical path and reserve image/font layout
Complete descriptive, canonical, and share metadata
